Recall report for a detection run

Source: R/05b_groundtruth_metrics.R
pam_recall_report.Rd

Compares a run's detections with the ground-truth annotations and writes recall_by_species_threshold.csv to <detections>/<run_id>/validation/. Only annotated segments from recordings the run processed are used.

Usage

pam_recall_report(
  cfg,
  run_id = cfg$birdnet$run_id,
  thresholds = NULL,
  pool = NULL
)

Arguments

cfg

A pam_config object.

run_id

Detection run.

thresholds

Confidence thresholds. Default: the band edges of validation$bands except the last.

pool

Optional pool from pam_validation_pool().

Value

A list: metrics (see pam_recall_metrics()), n_segments, n_no_species, n_other_only.
